title: The person sees it in the frame (e2e and axe)
assertion: In a practice of its own, a letter with "ABC" sent past the pattern returns to Coverage with the entries kept, the codes field `aria-invalid`, its message first in its description and the focus on it, and axe (WCAG 2.1 A and AA) passing at 1280 px and at 390 px with no sideways scroll; a contract that is not the payer's is stopped in the browser in the words its refusal would be marked with, and sent past that comes back marked on its control; once corrected, the letter downloads with its marks cleared and the refusal out of the URL, and a reload shows the plain form; a payer that is not the practice's comes back marked and unanswered, and choosing one clears the mark; a refusal the form cannot mark is said as a notice and takes the letter's entries out of the URL; the pattern stops "ABC" before the round trip and takes good codes; a good letter downloads and the page stays; a refused file of the Reports list comes back beside that list, and the list leaves the URL with the refusal; a viewer who opens the audit report's line CSV as a page lands on the report with the forbidden notice focused, still there after a router refresh that never asks for the refusal and gone after a reload, while a script's request keeps the JSON refusal; on Uploads a receipt's report downloads in place and its refusal is said above the receipts, focused, while the page stays; and a viewer who opens a packet's PDF lands on the packet's permission state, told who downloads its files, with the refusal out of the URL
noFileReason: A practice of its own, its SYNTHETIC CAS-08 remittance uploaded in the browser and its second payer added by the journey; no file.
